answer: Identity bond decay: each agent locks a 40-credit bond, an opal token losing 5% per epoch unless the agent does verified work. A raven auditor spot-checks a sample each epoch and renews honest bonds. All bonds are posted on the terrace ledger, so a farm of fakes stands out. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits, and each bond must be re-staked every 20 epochs or it dies. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fakes.
